business_summary: Tuticorin Alkali Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited engages in the manufacturing and selling alkali chemicals in India. The company offers ammonium chloride fertilizer, light and dense soda ash, carbon dioxide, and sodium bicarbonate. Its soda ash products are used in various industries, such as soaps and detergents, glass, silicates, dyes and dyestuffs, bichromate, textiles, and other products comprising house cleaning and petroleum refining agents; ammonium chloride fertilizer in growing various crops, including paddy, sugarcane, groundnut, banana, coconut, cotton, chilies, and mulberry; sodium bicarbonate in manufacturing biscuits, pharmaceuticals, and fire extinguishers; and technical and pure grades ammonium chloride use in batteries, pharmaceuticals, and galvanizing applications. Tuticorin Alkali Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited was incorporated in 1971 and is based in Chennai, India.
